system.description: The target takes root and turns into a tree over the following hour. The tree retains the target’s size, HP, senses, and facial appearance; possessions become part of it. The target cannot move, needs no food or water, and has Protection 4. Damage taken remains when it returns to normal; if the tree is felled, it bleeds and the target can die. The caster can end the curse.
system.summary: Turns the target into a tree, immobilizes it and increases its Protection.
